title: EsperSMP Hardcore
description: EsperSMP Hardcore Modpack is a lightweight Fabric modpack focused on performance, quality-of-life improvements, and fair PvP gameplay. Designed for the EsperSMP server, it enhances the Minecraft experience without changing vanilla mechanics.
body:
EsperSMP Hardcore Modpack
EsperSMP Hardcore is a lightweight Fabric modpack designed to enhance Minecraft while keeping the vanilla gameplay experience intact.
The pack focuses on performance, quality-of-life improvements, and visual enhancements, making it perfect for multiplayer servers and competitive PvP environments.

This modpack is the official client pack for the EsperSMP Hardcore server.

⚡ Performance Optimized
The modpack includes a carefully selected set of performance mods to ensure smooth gameplay even in large multiplayer environments.

Performance improvements include:

Faster chunk loading

Better entity and rendering performance

Improved networking

Reduced memory usage

These optimizations allow players to enjoy a stable and high-FPS experience, even on lower-end systems.

🎮 Quality of Life Improvements
Several client-side improvements make gameplay smoother and more convenient without giving players unfair advantages.

Included features:

Armor and status HUD improvements

Better inventory controls

Tooltips for shulker boxes and items

Minimap and world map

Improved chat visuals

Zoom functionality

These additions help players stay informed and organized during gameplay.

🎨 Visual Enhancements
The modpack supports optional visual improvements while keeping the classic Minecraft feel.

Visual features include:

Shader support

Dynamic lighting

Enhanced entity models and textures

Improved rendering options

Players can customize these settings depending on their system performance.

⚖️ Fair Multiplayer Experience
EsperSMP Hardcore is designed with fair multiplayer gameplay in mind.

No unfair PvP advantages

Balanced client-side utilities

Carefully selected mods

Consistent experience for all players

This ensures that gameplay remains competitive, skill-based, and enjoyable for everyone.

📥 Installation
Install the modpack via CurseForge.

Launch the game with the provided Fabric profile.

Join the EsperSMP server and start playing.

📢 Notes
This modpack is primarily intended for the EsperSMP Hardcore server.
The pack focuses on performance and usability rather than gameplay changes.
All mods belong to their respective creators.
The EsperSMP Hardcore Team
